# netcup_server_iso (Data Source)

The ISO attached to a netcup server (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_iso" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Read-Only

- `iso` (String) Name of the ISO, null without one.
- `iso_attached` (Boolean) Whether an ISO is attached.
